mapper.select: select p.portfolio_id as portfolioId, pp.portfolio_name as portfolioName, p.sec_acct_id as secManageAcctId, stlinfo.sec_acct_name as secManageAcctIdStr, p.amount/10000 as shareAmt from PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE p left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.portfolio_id=p.portfolio_id left join PTL_CAPACCT_INFO pc on p.PORTFOLIO_ID=pc.PORTFOLIO_ID and pc.acct_type='A01' left join stl_sec_acct_info stlinfo on p.sec_acct_id=stlinfo.sec_acct_id where p.HODING_TYPE = #{A_001,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and p.DATE_TYPE = 0 and p.cdate=#{platDate,jdbcType=DATE} and finprod_id=#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and p.amount>0 order by p.sec_acct_id,pc.ACCT_NO
